utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m just heading out now, but I’ll stop by after my errands and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. Have a good run of errands, and I’ll let you know if anything changes before you swing back by.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll check in after I’m done and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m free, and I can help with both of those. Put me on the list, and I’ll start sorting supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Rey — I’ve got you on the list for supply sorting. I’ll also note you for house checks if we need an extra hand.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll get started on the supplies and can step in for house checks if needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely — I can help carry boxes and keep things organized. Just point me where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Oren — I’m still sorting the drop-off list and labeling spare parts, so if you can start with the boxes near the table, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: You got it — I’ll start with the boxes by the table and keep them in order.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep spreading the word and I’ll ask a few more neighbors to help out too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — that’s helpful. I’ve only been hearing bits, so I’ll keep an ear out for what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep repeating the plan and round up a few more neighbors to help out, too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—I missed that update. I can organize the volunteer sign-up and check which tools we still need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — the volunteer sign-up can go at the community center parking lot, and I’ll keep the tool kits and spare batteries on the list.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it — I’ll get the sign-up set for the community center parking lot and check the tools list, too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ve got those — I’ll bring the Phillips screwdriver set and any spare zip ties I have.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thank you, Leo — that’s perfect. See you at the repair drive!

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: See you then.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just let me know, and I’ll have my toolbox ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — could you remind me what needs fixing and by when? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Of course — I’m hearing a few small fixes for the repair drive, and I can check the exact list and timing for you. I’ll have my toolbox ready once you’ve got the details.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday morning works for me. I’ll be there by 9 to help unload and sort.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Eli — I’ll see you Saturday at 9.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Faye. I’ll be there Saturday at 9 and ready to unload and sort.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Could you help sort the donated items and keep an eye out for any missing screws or zip ties?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sure — I can sort the donated items and keep an eye out for screws or zip ties. Just point me to where to start.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — the bins are by the front table; start with the hardware pile and flag anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, perfect — send me the details and I’ll start spreading the word right away. I can hit the community center first and then the corner market.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll send the details right over. The main thing we need right now is help getting the word out and checking volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll start with the community center and corner market, and I’ll round up a few volunteers too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll confirm who’s available first, then I’ll send the update.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just confirming — what time should I swing by?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira — could you swing by around 3 PM? I’ll confirm the rest of the crew and send the update right after.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Head to the community center parking lot first, then I can send you to the next busiest spot.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—send me to the community center parking lot first, and I’ll start inviting folks right away.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great—after that, I’ll send you to the library entrance next.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — I’ve got a clear spot set aside for you, and I’ll note anything we need to replace as you sort through the tools.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, Rosa — I’ll start sorting the tools and set aside anything that looks worn. I’ll bring the screwdriver set and gloves like I said.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam — that’s perfect. I’ll keep the list updated and make sure everything’s ready when you bring them over.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No rush, Dane — just send the missing items when you’re ready and I’ll keep track from there.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’m checking my notes now and I’ll send the missing items over in a minute.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, Dane — send them over whenever you’re ready, and I’ll keep track of what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve only heard a little too, so I’m glad they’re still sorting out what needs fixing and who can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, that sounds about right — I’ll take another look at the notice and see if there’s anything new. If I spot it, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Bo — I’d appreciate that. I’m still just catching bits here and there, so any update would help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, I’ll bring the tools. What time should I come by?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Mina — could you come by around 9 on Saturday? I’ll probably need to be reminded of the plan, but I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sounds good — I’ll be there at 9 on Saturday with the tools. Want me to bring anything else?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I’ll wait for your update, then I can help once we know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m on it — I’ll check the drive while I’m out and get back to you as soon as I know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. I’ll wait for your update before I pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m checking my notes now and I’ll send over the missing items shortly. If there’s still anything left after that, I can help cover it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Dane — send the missing items when you have them, and I’ll keep the curb table plan ready.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’ll send the missing items over in a bit and help with whatever’s still open.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that’d be great, Uli—I’ll ask around and let you know what’s still needed. It sounds like we’re getting close, thanks to everyone pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I appreciate you keeping it low-key and letting me know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You got it—I’ll keep it low-key and check back with the folks organizing it. I’ll let you know as soon as I hear what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday morning at the community center on Maple Street works for me. I’m still sorting the list, so if you can help carry the boxes, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Saturday morning at the community center on Maple Street sounds good—I’ll spread the word, remind folks to bring tools, and ask a few neighbors to help carry the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps a lot — thanks for spreading the word and lining up helpers. I’ll keep the list organized and have the boxes ready for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I can bring the tools and a few labels too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, that helps a lot — I’ll keep the supplies list updated, and just send me the missing items when you’ve checked your notes.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll check my notes and send over anything I’m missing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks, Gus. I’ll come by right after pickup and grab the tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Faye — I’ll have them ready for you right after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, see you then — right after pickup works for me.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it, Tess—I’ll bring the screwdriver set and gloves, and I can help sort the donated parts when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, wonderful—thanks, Sam! I’ll let you know if anything else pops up before the drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Tess—just let me know if there’s anything else you need before I head over.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, what time should I swing by?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Around 3 PM works best for me.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, 3 PM it is. Thanks for confirming — I’ll swing by then.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Mina — I can help a little, but it’d be best to keep it quiet for now.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That works for me — can you sort supplies or make a quiet call this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can sort supplies, and a quiet call this afternoon should be fine.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
